decisions.rationale: 依据本版实际独立检查 RV-7e20e220…（immutable_input=SC-b3a0e625…）：接口时序契约 PASS 且来源绑定完整（power 侧 round-5 gate 输入 077f7e54…/fd3dca61…；firmware 侧 FW-18 源码 9f5b2867…/e815763e…/5d5d29f8…；双侧执行绑定 job eng-9d45631d57148be4 / eng-68513e5516fb0bb8，consumed_sources 逐字匹配），delivery_version PASS、firmware_event_logic PASS；但 power_load_chain 实测 FAIL：整窗负载电荷 ≈899.62 µC、最小供电 0.1588 V 低于 1.8 V 工作域、存储侧 4.2→0.3528 V、mcu_rail 启动伪值 -1.316e6 V、load_pwl_equal=false，且模型适用性 UNEVALUABLE；pcb_connectivity_drc/schematic_bom_pins 需重查，geometry_fit/source_domain UNEVALUABLE。故不采用：不满足供能要求，按实际证据保留为审查候选。原采用版 SC-4c0da605… 保留不动；不修改器件/代码/仿真输入；policy-radio-duty、policy-burst-duty、sece-envelope 与 FW-*/PWR-* 冲突继续 OPEN，physical=NOT_TESTED、radio_verified=false。

SC1=SC-a1974dece1a65f85d410d4cd5438f1a72aa7db476da793ddc34e8feab7db56e8（父显式=SC-f9a059，round-1 真实变更：固件 FW-18 源码修订 DC-1b0cf63d→声明 DC-7d311e54 绑定复用目标构建 eng-68513e5516fb0bb8 (input dae8705a)；供电 round-5 负载依据 DC-abd4b3c9→声明 DC-da5dd4a6 绑定复用 SPICE 作业 eng-9d45631d57148be4 (input_receipt 88246685)；契约 IC-94a282ef）的独立检查 RV-5ecab3ff 为 FAIL：power_load_chain FAIL（声明电荷 899.62 uC vs 求解负载 899.62 uC 但 load_pwl_equal=false、最小供电 0.158753 V < 1.8 V、储能 4.2→0.3528 V、人工接通产生负 mcu_rail）；board_firmware_interfaces FAIL（timing contract 20/21 PASS，唯一 FAIL 为固件声明把 project-chain/load-timeline.json 绑定到基线旧 sha 6a959ca6，而集成树为 077f7e54，属跨域声明绑定陈旧，需在本轮修订）；schematic_bom_pins/pcb_connectivity_drc RECHECK_REQUIRED；geometry_fit/source_domain UNEVALUABLE；physical NOT_TESTED、native_jobs_dispatched=0。按既定计划进入 round-2：保持 SC1 为审查候选，不采用、不拒绝，交由两个原专业会话在 SC1 上继续一个真实小修订。

Round-2 candidate SC2=SC-e8f2f2e5b6b4709a69cfbe332fca9e76351764aa11e7a988382e31e2a066d4d9 (parent SC1=SC-a1974dece1a65f85d410d4cd5438f1a72aa7db476da793ddc34e8feab7db56e8), independent review RV-26974610a9b7f493e9a38348734abcec94cf97dba9bd901405fc1f789fc9dd71, native_jobs_dispatched=0, physical=NOT_TESTED. Evidence: (1) interface timing contract power-firmware-source-contract-v2 PASS with 25 checks - both declarations, the bound frozen source shas (main.c a514a560, app_policy.h e73f4fe5, app_policy.c e815763e, load-timeline cb0ea34c, gen d33e4fdc, interface-params e0561370, chain_joint.cir 0d8dcd26, project.json de4cb484) and the actual radio timing (187.5 ms advertising, 100/200 ms connection bound, 5000 ms sample, 5000 ms policy); (2) delivery_version PASS: 89 files, firmware execution binding job eng-42f734718d566c30 / project_sha 4506ff91 and power execution binding job eng-2cf474f68315a9d8 / project_sha db0d16de are exactly the frozen worker inputs of this version; (3) firmware_event_logic PASS by exact reuse of validated input RV-47646364; (4) power_load_chain now EVALUATED and FAILS with real solver numbers: minimum_supply_v 0.13350823643621074 V against the declared 1.8 V rail, storage_v falling 4.19999999994 -> 0.2966849698582461 V, minimum_mcu_v -1315962.1900000018 (negative artefact at the manual admission), load_pwl_equal false and load_charge_c 0.0009120850588268295 with declared_charge_c null (165130 points, raw trace 0f9c0c95); (5) pcb_connectivity_drc and schematic_bom_pins RECHECK_REQUIRED, geometry_fit and source_domain UNEVALUABLE (device parameters, SECE envelope), board firmware native audit pending. Decision: RETAIN_FOR_REVIEW. Not adopted, because the joint candidate provably cannot sustain the declared load from the declared one-way-average SECE envelope (supply collapses below the rail and the storage rail is emptied); not rejected, because the two consecutive rounds are complete and traceable - real firmware source revision (12/2250 -> 6/1125 ms burst window) with a fresh fixed S132 build, real solver-input re-emission of chain_joint.cir with the declared timeline, declaration revisions on both domains, a source-bound power-firmware contract, independent eight-gate checks and a byte-bound audit trail - so the remaining shortfall is a registered engineering gap, not a broken chain. The adopted version SC-4c0da605, the retained review branch SC-b3a0e625 and round-1 SC1 plus its release are left untouched. Conflict policy-radio-duty (5000 ms policy period vs 187.5 ms actual advertising interval), policy-burst-duty, sece-envelope and the whole PWR-01..PWR-16 set stay OPEN with their original status.

DC-bf33cb0136238f39b0cd453cf1d65759a97d0.rationale: rev11 = declaration-only commit: ONLY interfaces/firmware.json changed (83096b2b910519d2dca89d22535822c19baa4e59e5fde95d8277bc23341289b8 -> 8e36b332cd397d20aa20363dcf0d0c2f3a3a60126809d75d637f3af610c4c5c2). No source file touched, no wireless parameter changed, no EDA/Demo added. Contents: (1) top-level interface stays exactly the five v2 fields (187.5/100/200/5000/5000); (2) new facts.declaration_audit_rev11 records that the sources list is now pinned to THIS branch's rev10 tree (main.c 9f5b2867..., app_policy.c e815763e..., app_policy.h 5d5d29f8...) and that this supersedes the rev6 frozen-table pinning while FW-17 is kept verbatim and stays OPEN; (3) new facts.burst_activity_rev11 declares the real firmware activity read from the frozen source: APP_POLICY_BURST_EVENTS 12 / APP_POLICY_BURST_MS 2250 ms (12 x 187.5 ms) inside the 5000 ms policy period, start via APP_ACT_START_ADV -> ble_advertising_start(BLE_ADV_MODE_FAST) and stop via APP_ACT_STOP_ADV -> sd_ble_gap_adv_stop(m_advertising.adv_handle), no advertising action before the manual admission (main() no longer starts advertising), connected = 100/200 ms with no advertising, plus the two compile-time burst asserts and the rev10 target-build receipt (eng-68513e5516fb0bb8, SUCCEEDED, input dae8705a...) as the only build evidence; (4) sources: 3 firmware shas re-pinned to the rev10 tree, the other 8 re-read this revision and unchanged; (5) issues: policy-radio-duty, FW-01..FW-04, FW-06, FW-07, FW-11..FW-17 preserved verbatim (not deleted, not reconciled) and exactly ONE issue added: policy-burst-duty (2250/5000 duty bound, worst-case discovery latency up to 5000 ms, named after the source comment that tracks it). physical=NOT_TESTED, radio_verified=false.

DC-596368c68e767cb00d8b648b45b5c77ffad7d.rationale: Declaration-only revision (round 5): interfaces/power.json revision 4 -> 5 (sha b642a943... -> 2487da1b8de6c1645d766d0a0a6850c5e04d425db9f17b1526a810e9d3842100). Top-level v2 interface retained verbatim {rail_v 1.8, storage_initial_v 4.2, manual_admission true, sece_resolved false}; sources rebound to 12 IN-TREE files with exact frozen-tree shas (the round-5 load basis + emitter added; no project-fw-s132/* sha bound); facts record (a) the FW-18 gated burst activity with the firmware head DC-7ff1f1c9... and the shas observed there (app_policy.h 5d5d29f8..., app_policy.c e815763e..., main.c 6416f779...), noting revision 4's predicted post-integration shas are superseded, (b) the round-5 load-basis update and the solve receipt (job eng-9d45631d57148be4 SUCCEEDED, reused=true, input receipt 88246685..., zero solver runs, byte-identical emit input) plus the old-vs-new comparison (delta = 0; counterfactual advertising item 26.667 -> 12 events, -55%, 2.47% of the window charge), (c) the cross-tree note; PWR-01..PWR-13 retained, PWR-14 updated (root cause cross-branch visibility; text-only handling; the round-3 "187.5 ms cadence" premise superseded by FW-18's bounded burst) and PWR-15 added for the burst duty's effect on the energy account. No EDA/Demo/device/netlist/source edit; physical NOT_TESTED.

DC-7d311e54b565603050e5943353d6e2bd7f5fd.rationale: Firmware source-derived declaration for the FW-18 revision: required interface fields (advertising 187.5 ms, conn 100/200 ms, sample 5000 ms, policy_advertising 5000 ms) bound to the frozen file table (main.c 9f5b2867, app_policy.h 5d5d29f8, app_policy.c e815763e, plus the two project-chain inputs). Separate from the source revision so the source change still enters the build.

DC-da5dd4a61ae7a4a6cd4956f86eb7a46b2e928.rationale: V2-P01 round 1: power declaration re-based onto SC-f9a059... (was b642a943b5e085636b3f9be36d76fde7dabd155c556ec9b49e113a6bb94357f7, revision 4 of the previous base -> cd193d90cdf6f8bd53be8e6559d9eef6d350b228bf4a9664e338d5f123880a48). interface {rail_v 1.8, storage_initial_v 4.2, manual_admission true, sece_resolved false} unchanged and re-grounded by the extraction against this base (same four values). sources re-bound to this base's frozen file table: project-chain/load-timeline.json 077f7e54..., project-chain/gen-chain-load-r5.py fd3dca61..., project-chain/interface-params.json e0561370..., project-chain/chain_joint.cir 790c2ba9..., project-chain/project.json de4cb484.... No project-fw-s132/* sha is bound (PWR-14): this base's firmware tree is still the PRE-FW-18 revision (app_policy.h c05c98be... 7996 B without APP_POLICY_BURST_EVENTS/APP_ACT_STOP_ADV/adv_burst, app_policy.c a942c830... 13052 B = the round-3/4 base revision), while the FW-18 gate is observed at the firmware branch head DC-7ff1f1c9... (rev 9) - so the firmware files stay a cross-tree text reference and the firmware domain owns those shas. All 15 open issues (PWR-01..PWR-15) carried over unchanged; PWR-14/PWR-03b updated with the round-1 confirmations. Physical NOT_TESTED.

DC-5c4024462b48f7faab51d65e5afd7cfcd4d99.rationale: Declaration revision for the shortened burst window, committed separately so the source change still enters the build. sources bind ONLY files this domain owns that exist in this baseline's file table: project-fw-s132/main.c a514a560, project-fw-s132/app_policy.h e73f4fe5, project-fw-s132/app_policy.c e815763e. No cross-domain sha binding any more (the round-1 timing-contract FAIL came from binding project-chain/load-timeline.json to a sha that is not this tree's); the cross-domain payload is now referenced by TEXT ONLY. Interface fields unchanged (187.5 / 100 / 200 / 5000 / 5000 ms) - the burst-window change is not an interface field. issue policy-burst-duty updated to 1125 ms per 5000 ms, still OPEN.

DC-0ff11339d3b0031e941f974eebe7ef95fa5f1.rationale: V2-P01 round2 声明修订（power 域，仅 interfaces/power.json）：v7 记录本轮真实求解输入修订（notify 改为声明的 sample+150 ms/2 ms，修复 load_pwl_equal=false）、FW-18 门控常量对齐固件域 round2 修订（6/1125，声明场景内零影响）、电荷台账（1v8 域 1.80825e-3 C；储能轨参考 9.277236890756307e-4 C，相对 round5 +24 µC/+1.2100840336134454e-5 C 的因果）、以及 PWR-16 明确 load_pwl_equal 只能由 Lead 的独立 validate 重判。接口值（1.8 V/4.2 V/人工接通/sece_resolved=false）与全部未决问题不放松，未绑定 project-fw-s132/* sha（PWR-14）。

DC-4b460f65db3255e284edd7020760c638c72d2.rationale: interfaces/power.json v8: re-bind the sources sha of project-chain/load-timeline.json to the v5 revision (cb0ea34c...), keep the interface exactly rail_v 1.8 V / storage_initial_v 4.2 V / manual_admission true / sece_resolved false, keep every amplitude, referral K, gate constant 6/1125, window, charge and open issue, add the round-2 supplement (per-DC execute reuse records + why v5 moved) and close PWR-17 (v4 key-rename regression). No old conclusion relaxed; chain_joint.cir and the other sources unchanged.
